minor: Only one pair can connect with the mirrors the way they start. After that, every shot turns the mirrors it bounces off, and that's what opens up a path for the next pair. Look for a pair that's only a mirror or two away from getting home, then work out whose light would turn those mirrors for it.
major: Fire the circles first: with the mirrors the way they start, they're the only pair whose light gets home. Their light turns three mirrors, and after that the squares are the only pair that can connect, so fire them second. From there, keep asking the same question: which mirrors did that last shot turn, and who did it help?
